transitions.from: Shelter for Urban Homeless (SUH - Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - NULM)
transitions.to: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U / Housing for All)
transitions.reason: Shelter social workers assist in biometric Aadhaar generation and guide in-situ PMAY-U EWS housing allotment applications.

transitions.from: Shelter for Urban Homeless (SUH - Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - NULM)
transitions.to: Community Kitchens & Subsidized Canteens (Indira Rasoi / Amma Canteen)
transitions.reason: Night shelter inmates receive direct token vouchers for subsidized and community canteen daily meals.

transitions.from: Shakti Sadan (Swadhar Greh & Short Stay Homes for Women in Distress)
transitions.to: One Stop Centres (OSC - Sakhi Centres for Women in Crisis)
transitions.reason: Residents of short stay homes receive immediate police protection, forensic documentation, and crisis legal defense.

transitions.from: Shakti Sadan (Swadhar Greh & Short Stay Homes for Women in Distress)
transitions.to: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U / Housing for All)
transitions.reason: Rehabilitated survivors receive prioritized EWS quota housing applications upon completing vocational skill training.

transitions.from: Affordable Rental Housing Complexes (ARHCs)
transitions.to: PM SVANidhi Urban Vendor Shelter & Micro-Credit Upliftment
transitions.reason: ARHC tenants with informal livelihoods are fast-tracked for PM SVANidhi collateral-free working capital micro-loans.

transitions.from: National Disaster Relief Emergency Temporary Shelters (NDRF / SDRF)
transitions.to: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
transitions.reason: Disaster relief camp census enables fast-track priority sanction of PMAY-G disaster reconstruction financial grants.

transitions.from: State Slum Rehabilitation Authority (SRA / In-Situ Slum Redevelopment)
transitions.to: Affordable Rental Housing Complexes (ARHCs)
transitions.reason: Transit accommodation in ARHCs provided to eligible families while high-rise permanent rehabilitation tenements are under construction.

transitions.from: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY / NFSA Priority Households)
transitions.to: Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY - Deepest Poverty Food Entitlement)
transitions.reason: Households experiencing acute vulnerability or loss of primary earner can appeal for conversion from PHH to 35kg AAY cards.

transitions.from: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY / NFSA Priority Households)
transitions.to: One Nation One Ration Card (ONORC - Nationwide Portability)
transitions.reason: Existing ration cardholders can instantly enable biometric nationwide portability on the Mera Ration portal for interstate work.

transitions.from: Mission Poshan 2.0 (ICDS Anganwadi Supplementary Nutrition)
transitions.to: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY - Maternity Nutrition Benefit)
transitions.reason: Anganwadi workers directly register pregnant women on the Poshan Tracker and facilitate their Rs 5,000 PMMVY maternity DBT claim.

transitions.from: Mission Poshan 2.0 (ICDS Anganwadi Supplementary Nutrition)
transitions.to: PM POSHAN (Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman - Mid-Day Meal Scheme)
transitions.reason: Graduating Anganwadi children at age 6 are automatically transitioned into government primary school mid-day meal records.

transitions.from: Annapurna Scheme for Senior Citizens
transitions.to: Senior Citizen Assisted Living & Old Age Homes (Rashtriya Vayoshri & Shelter)
transitions.reason: Indigent seniors receiving Annapurna grain can apply for comprehensive assisted residential care when living independently becomes unviable.

transitions.from: Akshaya Patra & NGO Food Relief Network
transitions.to: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY / NFSA Priority Households)
transitions.reason: Emergency food kit distribution camps connect undocumented families with local Fair Price Shop ration enrollment drives.

transitions.from: Emergency Food Security Helpline (Dial 1967)
transitions.to: One Nation One Ration Card (ONORC - Nationwide Portability)
transitions.reason: Helpline grievance officers resolve biometric mismatch issues to restore nationwide ration lifting rights.

transitions.from: Ayushman Bharat - PM-JAY (Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana)
transitions.to: Rashtriya Arogya Nidhi (RAN - Treatment for Rare & Life-Threatening Diseases)
transitions.reason: When hospital treatment costs exceed the Rs 5 lakh PM-JAY annual ceiling, hospital superintendents submit RAN supplemental grant requests.

transitions.from: Ayushman Bharat Health and Wellness Centres (Ayushman Arogya Mandirs)
transitions.to: Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP Jan Aushadhi Kendras)
transitions.reason: Prescriptions from primary health wellness centres are linked with local Jan Aushadhi generic stores for medicines at 90% discount.

transitions.from: Ayushman Bharat Health and Wellness Centres (Ayushman Arogya Mandirs)
transitions.to: National Tuberculosis Elimination Program (NTEP - Nikshay Poshan Yojana)
transitions.reason: Positive screening at health wellness centres initiates instant Nikshay notification, free CBNAAT confirmation, and DBT cash support.

transitions.from: Janani Suraksha Yojana & JSSK (Institutional Delivery & Free Neonatal Care)
transitions.to: Mission Poshan 2.0 (ICDS Anganwadi Supplementary Nutrition)
transitions.reason: Newborns and post-natal mothers are enrolled directly by ASHA workers for Anganwadi supplementary take-home rations.

transitions.from: Tele-MANAS (Tele Mental Health Assistance and Networking Across States)
transitions.to: National Legal Services Authority (NALSA - Free Legal Aid Clinics)
transitions.reason: Counselors identify ongoing domestic harassment or property deprivation and connect distressed callers to DLSA legal aid lawyers.

transitions.from: National Tuberculosis Elimination Program (NTEP - Nikshay Poshan Yojana)
transitions.to: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY / NFSA Priority Households)
transitions.reason: TB patients without existing ration cards receive prioritized recommendation for food grain security to support nutritional recovery.

transitions.from: National Legal Services Authority (NALSA - Free Legal Aid Clinics)
transitions.to: District Legal Services Authority - Lok Adalat (Dispute Pre-Litigation & Settlement)
transitions.reason: Legal aid advocates refer civil disputes to upcoming National Lok Adalats for binding amicable settlement with complete court fee refund.

transitions.from: One Stop Centres (OSC - Sakhi Centres for Women in Crisis)
transitions.to: Shakti Sadan (Swadhar Greh & Short Stay Homes for Women in Distress)
transitions.reason: Victims of violence requiring extended shelter beyond 5 days at One Stop Centres are safely transferred to residential Shakti Sadan homes.

transitions.from: Tele-Law: Reaching the Unreached (Department of Justice & CSCs)
transitions.to: National Legal Services Authority (NALSA - Free Legal Aid Clinics)
transitions.reason: If pre-litigation advice indicates unavoidable court litigation, Tele-Law panel lawyers assign the case directly to DLSA for free representation.

transitions.from: Childline 1098 & District Child Protection Unit (DCPU / POCSO Support)
transitions.to: PM POSHAN (Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman - Mid-Day Meal Scheme)
transitions.reason: Rescued children restored to families or foster care are immediately admitted into local government schools with mid-day meal coverage.

transitions.from: Senior Citizens Maintenance and Welfare Tribunal (Maintenance Act 2007)
transitions.to: National Legal Services Authority (NALSA - Free Legal Aid Clinics)
transitions.reason: Senior citizens seeking enforcement of maintenance orders are provided dedicated pro bono advocates by the legal services authority.

transitions.from: Labour Commissioner Conciliation & e-Shram Worker Grievance Redressal
transitions.to: Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC Medical & Sickness Benefits)
transitions.reason: Investigation into informal contract labor reveals eligible establishments and triggers retrospective ESIC registration and health coverage.
